nodes.label: air-par-to-herd pass

nodes.label: air-ping-pong-transform pass
nodes.description: Detects and lowers double buffering opportunities by analyzing data production/consumption patterns in scf.for loops.

nodes.label: air-split-l2-memref pass
nodes.description: Tiles L2 memrefs to maximize memtile bandwidth utilization based on parallelizable data movements.

nodes.label: air-linalg-to-func pass
nodes.description: Links linalg.generic operations with external object files (.o) compiled for AIE core compute kernels.
